faqs.question: Do we have to switch CRMs, or can you optimize the one we use?
faqs.answer: Both are on the table. We can architect a fresh pipeline in Odoo or another CRM, or audit and rebuild the one you already run. If your current tool is the bottleneck, we will tell you honestly before any commitment.

faqs.question: Can leads from WhatsApp and our website land in the pipeline automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes. We capture leads from WhatsApp, web forms, and email into a single inbox, then route each one to the right rep with the source attached. That removes manual copy-paste and the leads that get lost in between.

faqs.question: How do you build a forecast we can actually rely on?
faqs.answer: We weight each deal by its stage probability and tie stages to real exit criteria, so the number reflects genuine momentum rather than optimism. Managers get conversion, velocity, and aging reports to see exactly where deals stall.

faqs.question: Will our sales team actually use it?
faqs.answer: That is the whole point of designing the pipeline around your real motion instead of a generic template. We keep data entry light, automate the busywork, and train reps hands-on so the CRM helps them close rather than slowing them down.

faqs.question: Do we own the pipeline and data after launch?
faqs.answer: Completely. You receive the configuration, the data, the documentation, and full administrator access. There is no lock-in — your team can run, adjust, and extend the pipeline independently.
